Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C,Krishna Agarawal Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
No one is present to press this petition though date and time has been fixed on the request of the learned counsel for the petitioners herein.
Sri Krishna Agarawal, learned Advocate has received notices on behalf of Respondent no.1.

Sri Apurva Hajela, learned Standing Counsel appearing for the State-respondents has pointed out that the instant writ petition suffers from inordinate unexplained laches, inasmuch as, the challenge is to the acquisition notification dated 25.10.2011 under Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894 and the award dated 02.09.2013 with respect to the land in question.

entities.text: Shiv Narayan And 9 Others vs Sachiv, Power Corporation Uttar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The prayer made in the writ petition that the writ petitioners are entitled for compensation as per the provisions of The Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013 (Act No.30 of 2013), is misconceived.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013 (Act No.30 of 2013)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Noticing the prayer made in the writ petition, we find that the writ petition suffers from inordinate unexplained laches on the part of the writ petitioners challenging the acquisition notification dated 25.10.2011 after 10 years of the conclusion of the acquisition proceedings by way of the award dated 02.09.2013.
The writ petition is misconceived and hence dismissed.
